verses.titus 1:1: Titus 1:1 Paul, a bondservant of God and an apostle of Jesus Christ, according to the faith of God's elect and the acknowledgment of the truth which accords with godliness,(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:2: Titus 1:2 in hope of eternal life which God, who cannot lie, promised before time began,(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:3: Titus 1:3 but has in due time manifested His word through preaching, which was committed to me according to the commandment of God our Savior;(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:4: Titus 1:4 To Titus, a true son in our common faith: Grace, mercy, and peace from God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ our Savior.(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:5: Titus 1:5 For this reason I left you in Crete, that you should set in order the things that are lacking, and appoint elders in every city as I commanded you"”(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:6: Titus 1:6 if a man is blameless, the husband of one wife, having faithful children not accused of dissipation or insubordination.(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:7: Titus 1:7 For a bishop must be blameless, as a steward of God, not self-willed, not quick-tempered, not given to wine, not violent, not greedy for money,(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:8: Titus 1:8 but hospitable, a lover of what is good, sober-minded, just, holy, self-controlled,(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:9: Titus 1:9 holding fast the faithful word as he has been taught, that he may be able, by sound doctrine, both to exhort and convict those who contradict.(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:10: Titus 1:10 For there are many insubordinate, both idle talkers and deceivers, especially those of the circumcision,(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:11: Titus 1:11 whose mouths must be stopped, who subvert whole households, teaching things which they ought not, for the sake of dishonest gain.(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:12: Titus 1:12 One of them, a prophet of their own, said, "Cretans are always liars, evil beasts, lazy gluttons."(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:13: Titus 1:13 This testimony is true. Therefore rebuke them sharply, that they may be sound in the faith,(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:14: Titus 1:14 not giving heed to Jewish fables and commandments of men who turn from the truth.(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:15: Titus 1:15 To the pure all things are pure, but to those who are defiled and unbelieving nothing is pure; but even their mind and conscience are defiled.(NKJV)
verses.titus 1:16: Titus 1:16 They profess to know God, but in works they deny Him, being abominable, disobedient, and disqualified for every good work.(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:1: Titus 2:1 But as for you, speak the things which are proper for sound doctrine:(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:2: Titus 2:2 that the older men be sober, reverent, temperate, sound in faith, in love, in patience;(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:3: Titus 2:3 the older women likewise, that they be reverent in behavior, not slanderers, not given to much wine, teachers of good things"”(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:4: Titus 2:4 that they admonish the young women to love their husbands, to love their children,(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:5: Titus 2:5 to be discreet, chaste, homemakers, good, obedient to their own husbands, that the word of God may not be blasphemed.(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:6: Titus 2:6 Likewise, exhort the young men to be sober-minded,(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:7: Titus 2:7 in all things showing yourself to be a pattern of good works; in doctrine showing integrity, reverence, incorruptibility,(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:8: Titus 2:8 sound speech that cannot be condemned, that one who is an opponent may be ashamed, having nothing evil to say of you.(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:9: Titus 2:9 Exhort bondservants to be obedient to their own masters, to be well pleasing in all things, not answering back,(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:10: Titus 2:10 not pilfering, but showing all good fidelity, that they may adorn the doctrine of God our Savior in all things.(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:11: Titus 2:11 For the grace of God that brings salvation has appeared to all men,(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:12: Titus 2:12 teaching us that, denying ungodliness and worldly lusts, we should live soberly, righteously, and godly in the present age,(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:13: Titus 2:13 looking for the blessed hope and glorious appearing of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ,(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:14: Titus 2:14 who gave Himself for us, that He might redeem us from every lawless deed and purify for Himself His own special people, zealous for good works.(NKJV)
verses.titus 2:15: Titus 2:15 Speak these things, exhort, and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:1: Titus 3:1 Remind them to be subject to rulers and authorities, to obey, to be ready for every good work,(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:2: Titus 3:2 to speak evil of no one, to be peaceable, gentle, showing all humility to all men.(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:3: Titus 3:3 For we ourselves were also once foolish, disobedient, deceived, serving various lusts and pleasures, living in malice and envy, hateful and hating one another.(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:4: Titus 3:4 But when the kindness and the love of God our Savior toward man appeared,(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:5: Titus 3:5 not by works of righteousness which we have done, but according to His mercy He saved us, through the washing of regeneration and renewing of the Holy Spirit,(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:6: Titus 3:6 whom He poured out on us abundantly through Jesus Christ our Savior,(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:7: Titus 3:7 that having been justified by His grace we should become heirs according to the hope of eternal life.(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:8: Titus 3:8 This is a faithful saying, and these things I want you to affirm constantly, that those who have believed in God should be careful to maintain good works. These things are good and profitable to men.(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:9: Titus 3:9 But avoid foolish disputes, genealogies, contentions, and strivings about the law; for they are unprofitable and useless.(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:10: Titus 3:10 Reject a divisive man after the first and second admonition,(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:11: Titus 3:11 knowing that such a person is warped and sinning, being self-condemned.(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:12: Titus 3:12 When I send Artemas to you, or Tychicus, be diligent to come to me at Nicopolis, for I have decided to spend the winter there.(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:13: Titus 3:13 Send Zenas the lawyer and Apollos on their journey with haste, that they may lack nothing.(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:14: Titus 3:14 And let our people also learn to maintain good works, to meet urgent needs, that they may not be unfruitful.(NKJV)
verses.titus 3:15: Titus 3:15 All who are with me greet you. Greet those who love us in the faith. Grace be with you all. Amen.(NKJV)
